sloka: स्थाल्य: कुम्भ्य: करम्भ्यश्च दधिपूर्णा: सुसंस्कृता: ।यौवनस्थस्य गौरस्य कपित्थस्य सुगन्धिन: ॥ २.९१.७१॥
transliteration: sthālya: kumbhya: karambhyaśca dadhipūrṇā: susaṁskṛtā: ।yauvanasthasya gaurasya kapitthasya sugandhina: ॥ 2.91.71॥

translations.english: The wells were found filled with datepalm liquor and surrounded by pots of well cooked meat of peacocks, chicken and other animals.
